common_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished full-scene fashion illustration in portrait 2:3, at least 1024×1536 pixels. The supplied original published-site character atlas is the AUTHORITATIVE character identity and drawing-style reference. It shows the SAME woman in several poses; output just ONE woman in ONE environment, not an atlas or collage.
CHARACTER/STYLE LOCK: preserve the published avatar's exact recognizable soft face, expressive brown eyes, face shape, eye/eyebrow spacing, skin tone, long wavy chestnut-brown hair and side part. Young East Asian adult woman, natural elongated fashion proportions about eight heads tall, calm confident expression and upright open-chested posture. Match the published reference's refined illustrated face/hair/fabric rendering, clean precise contours and gentle soft shading. Retain its natural adult fashion character. Use muted cream, sand, terracotta, dusty blue and sage with subtle paper grain and soft natural daylight. Keep the scene in that same coherent illustration style. No heavy black outlines, chibi proportions, photorealism, glossy 3D, or a redesigned face. When a second reference is supplied it is Scene 1 of this SAME series: use it to keep the rendering, face, body scale and palette consistent, but draw the requested new scene and outfit.
COMPOSITION LOCK: full body from top of hair to the bottom of BOTH shoes' soles, all hands/props/shoes intact and uncropped. Center the woman approximately; she occupies about 70–75% of image height, with generous balanced clear space above the head and clear floor below the feet, each NEVER less than 8% of total image height. Do not zoom in. Keep adult anatomy/proportions consistent. The environment and scene equipment sit behind or beside her, never occluding her head, torso, legs or shoes; her complete silhouette should be clean for later extraction. No foreground counter or furniture across her legs. No extra people. No text, letters, numerals, signs, logos, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including screens, diplomas and fridge magnets. No border, frame or split panels. Only this one requested scene.
MATCH THE APPARENT PERSON SCALE TO THE SECOND (SCENE1) REFERENCE: roughly70%canvasheight with ampleheadroomandground, not a tight nearly-edge-to-edge portrait.
